review: The hosts were very helpful. The location was very close to the historical centre, and it was easy to walk to the main points of interest. The interior stone finish is very attractive. Since the apartment was located at street level, we could not keep the window open because of the constant noise from passersby, so there was no air circulation.
The host was very easy to communicate with, the location was perfect, the apartment was great, very spacious, very clean - would highly recommend!
The shower was too small and AC was slow
I wouldn't change anything , it was a beautiful experience Thank you again

The breakfast was impeccable and the breakfast hours were nice. Cute place with a pretty view. The staff were kind. Price was reasonable. We had a tub and the hot water was endless. It was great to be able to have a bath. Loved the mini toothpaste and accessories included in the bathroom. It was really hard to find. I recommend pictures of the path into the courtyard so that people can identify the correct place to turn into. I wish we could have two keycards but it is what it is.
Very central. Nice room, kitchen and shared bathroom. When you arrive, it's not clear which appartment to ring. You need to make sure to ask before if you don't have Internet.
The Cicadas are very cool, they're as loud as an ambulance basically and they're right outside the hotel. Also the parking was ok as they had parking on site.
A wonderful stay! The house was spotless and cozy, and the host was incredibly kind and helpful. Everything made my visit truly memorable. Highly recommended!
Location was good, calm, the pool is amazing, the view on the etna is breath taking

The room we had on the first night was quite small, but the subsequent room for 3 nights was comfortable. The breakfast was great and the bar area was a peaceful sanctuary. The walk into the center of town was reasonably long, as was the walk to the closest laundromat, but outside of that we had a very nice e stay.

The room had a nice decoration stone ceiling that looked so wonderful but at night it rained little stones and dirt on your head. The view was nice but the window high. The arrival at the hotel was complicated via What's app. The indication to the parking was not suffisant. The pick up was an extra charge per personne. Don't book the nice looking cave room it's raining dirt all night we left 1 day earlier. Cleaning lady just gave us towels she did not clean up anything. There is no space to be outside. In the restaurant we waited more than 1 hour for a tataki the server had to many people to serve.
close to the airport and walking distance to the beach breakfast room upstair has a nice view and comfortable .
Lack of some kitchen tools and appliances:a cutting knife, kettle, toaster.

Breakfast was lovely - served family style! The property was very peaceful and quiet, with no crowds of people. Loved the pool area with the beautiful green surroundings and stylish sun beds, great place to unwind after a day of exploring. The suite itself was stunning also - super chic, spotless and comfortable! Overall the location was great - short drive to see the ruins and to Agrigento city centre! The only thing that I’d consider a small ‘minus’ is that there is a main road right next to the resort, so when outside by the pool, you can hear the cars pass by - BUT honestly considering how excellent everything else was and the overall value for the money, this didn’t ruin the experience for us! In the suite itself, it was super quiet and you couldn’t hear any noise at all. I would definitely recommend this property and would be happy to come back again! Thank you Krizia and Concetta! ☺️
Suite was spacious, very comfortable and clean. Everything was perfect, no complains.

The location was absolutely perfect--Almost next door to S. M Novella (don't miss it!) and close to all the main sites. The suite was clean and well appointed and there was daily housekeeping. What stands out for us though was the friendliness and helpfulness of the host, Francesco. Check-in was clear and he was there to welcome us. He called cabs for us whenever required, He responded quickly to all questions and, an added bonus, he recommended a restaurant (2 minute walk) that served the most delicious food (take out or eat in) while catering to all my dietary restrictions. Thank you so much!!!

The host was absolutely lovely. So attentive and kind, explained the breakfast and made sure I always had access to the building. He made my stay very pleasant! Very central location, too. Thank you :)

Loved the location. Close to restaurants and close to vaporetto! Kitchen was well furnished. We loved the bar downstairs!!! They close by midnight and if you close the shutters all is good but we decided to join them! Great for families The beds are thin but ok. There are mosquitoes but I think that is normal for the season.
Very clean very comfy bed super nice Host!
Great place to stay.
It had a washing machine Hard to find No good restaurants anywhere close Basement suite...dark, brick floors, musty smelling
Fantastic location The nice central location means that in the weekend there is a lot of chatter outside (very friendly sound), as well as street cleaning early in the morning (noisy).
Great breakfast, great location! Amazing, friendly staff, thank you Deborah!

Review for Villa Ana – 10/10! My stay at Villa Ana was truly memorable. From the moment I booked, Giovanna.the sweetest and kindest host, made me feel at home! . I had a 2 day layover and found this incredible place near the airport at an unbeatable price. Shortly after I confirmed my booking, Giovanna reached out to me via WhatsApp. She was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. When I arrived, it honestly felt like I had arrived at my very own villa. The room was cozy and thoughtfully prepared with complimentary juices, water, and a lovely breakfast basket. Giovanna also helped me find an excellent car rental service just steps away from the villa, which made things even more convenient. Overall, the experience was relaxing and personal, like a home away from home. I highly recommend Villa Ana to anyone arriving or departing from the airport. It’s a true hidden gem, and I will definitely be staying there again. 10/10

The apartment is new, and it had almost everything needed for a family stay (enough beds, dish washer, washing machine, fridge, 2 TVs ... etc), it has dedicated parking in the basement of the building, self check-in, super market 2 min. away from the building. There are plenty of food places around. The instructions provided for the self check-in were clear to follow. I rented a car so I did not really explore the location in terms of nearest bus or metro station, but it is about 30 min. ride from central Rome. The description said it is an air-conditioned property, however we found out there is only 1 AC in the living area and no ACs in the 2 bedrooms or fans which was very inconvenient for us specially that Rome is hot in August, so we had to go sleep in the living area every night and this was the worst part of the experience to move 2 mattresses outside every night and return them back in the morning. It would also be an added value to have shampoo/soap in the washroom.
This is the best apparent that we ranted for the last 5 years! Location, size, cleanliness, terrace, view, owner- all 100% great! morning garbage pick up.. Just a small special thing ))
Great host Smaller then I thought

The bed was super comfortable, and the place was clean. It is located in a calm and quiet courtyard, close to the beach. The owner was super helpful, letting me know about nearby places to visit and restaurants to eat at. Easy transportation to Sorrento, 2 train stops, or a 30-minute bus ride. Highly recommend.

It’s close to the airport and there’s air conditioning. There was an entire COLONY of ants in our room. The other room was fine. We only spent a night because it’s close to the airport so the location is great. The concierge was ok at first. Then the British villain looking one (concierge with white hair and glasses) had an attitude. And didn’t even apologise for the atrocities we found in the room. We changed the room (was offered with attitude off course) as we couldn’t stay with the ants and it smelled like socks.
Very nice hosts, very clean and great breakfast.

The location is perfect. There is a restaurant, Gelato and breakfast place right at the end of the street so you don't have to hunt for food when you arrive if you don't have the energy. The hosts gave excellent instructions on how to get to the room and the "key" is on your phone ( so handy!!). It's quiet, clean and the bed is comfortable. The room is in a small apartment with 3 other rooms ( each of their own locks), there is a main space where you can fill up water and grab a coffee. We loved our time here! The only downside is the stairwell is quite dark when coming home in the evening. We discovered the last day the lights on the wall to turn them on.

Our room was so spacious, and a balcony was a nice bonus! The staff were friendly and helpful. The restaurant at the hotel served an excellent dinner! There was nothing we didn’t like. Our stay was excellent, and we would book here again if we were in the area.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The location is unbeatable Right on Piazza San Marco! The room was clean, elegant, and quiet, with everything we needed. The staff was kind and very helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to experience the heart of Venice!
Nice, clean and spacious place with plenty of restaurants and stores around. Pretty easy to get to with public transportation.
Very good location and clean room
Property and location Staff not helpful..

Great location just steps to the major piazza8 and Sassi district, also close to train station and some intercity busses (e.g.Bari Airport) The reception desk was very accommodating, polite, and professional. The room was very comfortable and clean. Our request for a higher level room was fulfilled. The breakfast was very tasty and consisted of a variety of choices. Very comfortable and pleasant stay. Thank you to all teams of this hotel. We wish the room to be equipped with a kattle for tea/coffee. The hotel management should consider changing carpets in the halls.

This hotel has an elegance to it. Not like new places - it evokes a time from the past. You can tell that many people come again and again and are welcomed like family by the staff. The staff were amazingly helpful and kind. Beach is great and well maintained Parking is a bit of a challenge, but not a major disruption
Maurizio was a very caring host.
Great location, easy access to all the main areas, history and beauty is at reach. Don't miss the Market Trionfale near by! Rooms are comfortable and elegant.
Excellent location. Everything was perfect

Amazing breakfast, great value for money. the staff were friendly and informed us of thunderstorms & weather. The best part was there were bikes for rental at a nearby store, and free parking. The hot tub and sauna facilities were very clean
The staff went above and beyond to make our stay pleasurable. Not a thing. It was a great place to stay.

Very clean, friendly greeting, easy access and instructions. Nice amenities and location is excellent. Bed very comfortable, shower nice to see full size, not so common in Italy! Free parking was maybe a bit difficult, not really an inclusion. Paid parking reasonable and very, very convenient.
The location, cleanliness and the facilities The elevator
Great breakfast, great accomodations, like a paradise hidden in the hills! Carlo was an amazing host going out of his way to accomodate. His staff is wonderful, we'll be back! Grazie Tante!
The staff were super nice Wifi was spotty
Everything was beautiful Everything was beautiful
The location was great, and the staff were very friendly and accommodating. Air conditioning could not keep up with the summer heat.

First of all the 2 hosts Antonino & Francesca are extremely nice and attentive, readily available to help you with anything you need. The place is super clean, with everything you need for your stay from laundry detergent, Q-tips, cotton pads, shampoo, body wash, coffee capsules etc they even had a basket on the table full of croissants, jam, muffins, mini toast as well as water, juices, rose wine in a small can, bread etc We stayed with our 2 toddlers and they were completely comfortable sleeping in the double sofa bed. The walk to the bus station is about 8min (on a hill) and the bus ride €2 to Sorrento Center about 10min. It's a perfect location to visit Sorrento, Capri or take the bus €3 to Amalfi & Positano. I would definitely come back to this place! You just have to be extra careful when walking on the road to get to the apartment due to the reduced sidewalks, but if we did it with a stroller, you can definitely do it too :)
T'was a very nice hotel, friendly staff, great location and amazing rooftop restaurant for drinks and dinner...

This apartment in Taormina was incredible. The views were breathtaking—panoramic scenes of the sea, and mountain area. The apartment was huge, spacious, the deck was massive, spotless, well-equipped, with everything we needed. It was clear the place is brand new, well cared for, with stylish touches and a focus on cleanliness throughout. There was a lot of thought put into details- bath robes, slippers, shower gel. Beds were amazing and comfortable, linens were awesome, shower pressure was fantastic all around awesome. The location was perfect- 150 m to the entrance of the upper historic center, shops, and restaurants, the bus station, cable car all within 10 minute walk and a 30 min walk downhill to the beaches. Our host was fabulous, responsive, and full of helpful tips and resto recommendations. He went out of his way to secure tickets for an event while we were there which was amazing and appreciated because i know it was an ask! If you're looking for a place in Taormina that offers incredible space, comfort, awesome views, and a bit of indulgence, this is it. Highly recommended—we didn’t want to leave and cannot wait to return! There was absolutely nothing not to like. There were quite a few stairs to get down to the apartment and then obviously back up, so people with mobility issues might have a bit of a challenge.
Very clean. Host very nice and helpfull.
There's meat or eggs in the breakfast

Amazing delicious breakfast with eggs, bacon, fresh croissants, coffee and other foods. Storage for our bicycles that we rented was much appreciated. Great location; very close to the port and to restaurants, cafes, etc.

the location was very good The stairs!! We had heavy bags and the person there only carried up one. We had to leave early so we were on our own to get the bags downstairs. It was horrible. We are in good shape and there were over 30 steep stairs which were very difficult. I would suggest its a great place to stay if you have a back pack and that's it.
Great location close to main street and the waterfront. Bathroom, needs updating. Difficult getting in & out of tub/shower.

The pictures of this place don't do it justice. The views are absolutely breathtaking! It was amazing staying here. The rooms were super clean and comfortable. As well the pool was great for those super hot days as well as the air conditioning in the rooms. We were lucky not to always need the air conditioner as it cooled down overnight and we were able to leave the windows open and get a beautiful cross breeze in the rooms. The staff were also wonderful. I would love to stay here again! The only thing we didn't like was that the water while showering was difficult to maintain a specific temperature and would fluctuate between super hot and cold. Once I was used to this I didn't mind because I'm ok with coldish showers but the first time it happened was a shock.
Worst service ever , no instructions for self checking in nor for check out..
The rooms were newly renovated and the location was excellent steps from the beach!

What an great place to stay when you have to spend a night or two near the Rome Fiumicino airport! The owner is amazing. The guest house is cozy and confortable. It's a short walk to the beach, and there's a grocery store nearby. The free shuttle service is perfect!

Great property and the owner is very nice and welcoming. He talks to every guest and really works on making sure your experience is great! He has a lot of good insights of the region too and is always happy to help.
The location was excellent and the check in was very easy! Cetty was an excellent help!

The location was great as was the manager. Still awkward to find. Very austere unit with no decor. Air conditioning was inadequate for the unit and the washroom was especially intolerably hot. Little place to put luggage. See above.
Everything mentioned was accurate and good. Between the room, small step. Be mindful as you may hit. After one day we are used to.
It's like an all-inclusive - great infity pool and services as well as breakfast and dinner
Great room, clean and nice. Good balcony. Quiet and nice Breakfast could be a bit closer (it's a bar on a corner of the street and a big bigger, but it's typical for Italy).
Very clean and comfortable No shuttle
No air conditioner ruined my trip!
The room was nice and comfortable, the staff was helpful! There are many stores nearby as well as close metro station.

The beds were comfortable. This is a review of the 2 bedroom apartment. It is down the street from the actual hotel in the downtown area of the city so the map location of the hotel does not represent where this unit is. It is above a gelato place that stays open until 12am each night, and has a scooter park as it is the last place someone can drive to before entering the walking only part of the downtown. The noise was excessive and until 2 or 3am Saturday, Sunday nights, 1am Monday and Tuesday. People talking, yelling, scooter engines backfiring, etc. It is a popular corner for all the night life, which is not exactly great for a family. The listing states air conditioning which it does not have so it is a furnace without the windows open. The listing also shows a balcony of the 2 bedroom which it does not at all have. The listing says 900 sqft, it is actually maybe 450. The actual hotel rooms might be fine, we have no idea but huge warning about the 2 bedroom

The only good thing about this place is the location. But there are many other options available now around Rome Termini 1. The locker was broken and no lock provided. 2. I booked a 4 bed room but they put me in an 8 bed room (to be fair the lady at the counter refunded the difference during checkout). 3. The washroom was not clean. 4. The bedsheets had yellow stains. 5. The elevator was not working and the person at the counter was dismissive. I had to walk up the stairs to close the elevator door that was stuck open so I could use the elevator to take my luggage to my room. 6. The person during check-in was not good at communicating. He talks fast and dismissively because he doesn't want to do deal with customer's concerns. 7. Not ideal for long term stay.

Amazing location near centre of old town - next to Teatro Massimo and surrounded by local restaurants, small bars and market area. Secure and attractive building interior. Lift in operation to all floors. Spacious apartment, high ceilings - living/kitchen area separate to bedroom. Bathroom good - excellent shower with gels/shampoos provided. Bedroom - vg size and bed very comfortable. Full height windows open on to small balconies. Able to leave luggage in secure area after last-day checkout Owner very responsive and helpful. Excellent value for money.
Quite Not a good location
very quite at night to sleep, There were quite a few items was provided for breakfast ,like coffee, pastries etc.
Loved the building and architectural features. Our hosts were friendly and welcoming. The restaurant directly below was excellent.

Apartment is in ZTL zone. Host did not disclose this information. Be aware if he advises you to park on the street. Communication with text only. Sending messages in Italian and English. To use air-condition, you need to open a window so exhaust can blow out. It cools only one room. Located beside very noisy street. You'll regret opening a window during night and you will have to open it if you want to use A/C. Bathroom smells like mold.
LOCATION Staff and air conditioning not working well

The appartment has two bedrooms which was perfect for our family of four. Very clean and comfortable. The location is amazing. Close to the main attractions. Roby was an amazing host that communicated with us all the time to make sure our stay was going well. I highly recommend this apartment for those who are visiting Florence The two bedrooms has air conditioner but the cool air didn't reach the other areas like the living room, kitchen and bathroom, so it was hot in the other rooms

The apartment is located in a good neighborhood close to orange metro line, shops, parks, and the ruins of aqueducts, which transported water to Rome, a masterpiece of roman engineering. It's spacious, newly renovated with high-quality materials and furniture, 3 a/c units, 2 bathrooms (washer and dryer a big plus for us) and fully equipped kitchen. Our vacation was unforgettable, and a part of it was the good choice we made when booking for Roman Ruins House. A big thanks to the owner and my first choice when we'll return to Rome.

Beautiful property, we had the whole floor with huge terrace overlooking the see! Breakfast near the pool was outstanding too. The place is very quiet and relaxing! The shower on top floor is tiny due to the sealing , but on top floor nothing could be done, we understand, but the whole floor floor is a great privilege on top floor .
The host was nice and professional. The place is so big. The location is ideal. Well, it is not the fault of the host, but parking was an issue - too far.
Front to Termini station No comments

Very clean, comfortable, beautiful, exceptional service. 100% recommended.
Hotel restaurant especially staff of restaurant

This hotel is spotless and features a charming terrace, making it a perfect place to relax. Its convenient location near Fiumicino Airport is ideal for travelers. The host, Maurizio, is exceptionally warm and always ready to assist with anything you may need. Guests can enjoy a light breakfast, and the lobby fridge is thoughtfully stocked with cold water and juices for your comfort.
There was no cutting knife

Communication with Raffaele was amazing. He helps us on so many different things, early check in, we got there 2 hrs sooner. Late check out 2hrs late. Directions to go around for food and other stuff, even send us a navette for our ride to the airport. The communication by whatsapp started before arriving and finished after we left. You cant ask for more dedication and commitment to a visitirs than Raffaele gave us. Nothing.
